annotations.title: Fed rate odds from futures (FedWatch method)

description: What the futures market expects the Fed to do: from 30-day fed funds futures, the rate implied after each scheduled FOMC meeting, the expected change there and from today, the chances of no change, a hike or a cut, and of each target range after each meeting, by the method CME's FedWatch publishes, with the contracts behind it and today's range and effective rate. A plain summary first. No key.

meetings.description: Scheduled FOMC meetings shown, soonest first; default 8.

name: rate_expectations

outputSchema.description: meetings is a table of each coming FOMC meeting with the rate implied after it, the expected change (basis points) and the chances of no change, a hike or a cut; target_ranges gives each range's chance after each meeting (percent); futures lists the contracts used.

title: Fed rate odds from futures (FedWatch method)
